row.Composition / filler: "Highly conductive copper-filled thermoplastic filament" with "a percolated copper network embedded in a thermoplastic matrix" (R-MULTI3D-ELECTRIFI-TDS, p. 1); its safety data sheet lists "biodegradable polyester" and "Conductive Filler" and gives a melting point of "Approximately 60 °C" (R-MULTI3D-ELECTRIFI-SDS, pp. 1, 3). Inferred filing (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-20, R227, D176): the one biodegradable polyester that melts near 60 °C is polycaprolactone, and its 140-160 °C nozzle and soft, low-modulus filament are a PCL's; the maker names no polymer.
row.Colour caveat: Properties may vary by colour; use TDS scope
row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-20, b49)
row.Diameter compatibility: Check 1.75 mm variant; diameter is not part tolerance
